name: Burrowick
lore: A quarry gopher who dips beneath the ground in a smooth digging rhythm. Attacking stops movement and forces a surface. Four visible tunnel sections guide Cave In and slow foes crossing them.

primary.name: Quarry Claws
primary.description: Two quick close swipes, 18 damage each. Each hit has a 40% chance to cause bleeding for 3 seconds (2 damage per second).

secondary.name: Pop-up Pounce
secondary.description: Burrow up to 560 along a clear path, then erupt in a 65-radius splash and stun for 1s. Attacks and walking pause during the dive.

special.name: Cave In
special.description: Collapse the four numbered tunnel sections after a 0.65s warning. Each enemy takes damage once. Your visible trails also slow crossing enemies by 20%.

passive: Packed Earth: Pop-up Pounce grants 12% damage reduction for 2s after surfacing.

technique.name: Gentle Excavation
technique.description: Pounce has a larger 90-radius impact and 1.5s stun, but deals 25 damage.

final_technique.name: Faultline
final_technique.description: Replace your trail collapse with one aimed 340-range crack. Less damage, reliable reach and a longer slow.

attack.name: Faultline
attack.description: Warn for 0.65s, then crack a straight 340-range strip for 52 damage and a 3s slow.
